query: SELECT district, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, status, notes FROM house_races WHERE state_code = 'CA' ORDER BY CAST(district AS UNSIGNED);

rows.notes: CA top-2 primary June 2026. D: Mike McGuire (CA Senate leader). R TBD. Special election for current seat Aug 4, 2026.
Kevin Kiley (R) represented the old CA-3 but is running in CA-6 after redistricting. This is effectively an open seat in the new CA-3.

Ballots still counting as of Jun 3. Kevin Kiley (Ind., incumbent) leads at 26.8%. Second spot uncalled: Michael Stansfield (R) at 22.2% vs Richard Pan (D) at 21.2% — separated by ~1%. Est. 116,000 ballots remaining. AP has not called the 2nd spot. (Source: NBC News / AP, 47.8% in)

Ballots still counting as of Jun 3. Doris Matsui (D, incumbent) leads at 30.6%. Second spot uncalled: Mai Vang (D) at 24.9% vs Zachariah Wooden (R) at 24.1% — separated by <1%. Est. 120,000 ballots remaining in Sacramento County alone. AP has not called the 2nd spot. (Source: NYT / AP, 47% in)

Nancy Pelosi (D) is retiring. This is an open seat top-two jungle primary. Key candidates include Saikat Chakrabarti, Connie Chan, and Scott Wiener (all D). Top two finishers advance to November regardless of party.
AP called: Lateefah Simon (D, incumbent) and Jamie Joyce (D) both advance to the November general election. D vs D matchup — no Republican in the race. (Source: AP / NBC News, Jun 3 2026)
CA top-two primary Jun 2. D: Adam Gray (incumbent), Daniel Garibay Rodriguez. R: Vin Kruttiventi, Kevin Lincoln II.

Rep. Eric Swalwell (D) resigned from Congress. Gov. Gavin Newsom called a special primary for June 16, 2026. If no candidate wins a majority, the top two advance to an August 18, 2026 runoff. The winner serves out the remainder of Swalwell's term through January 2027.

Ballots still counting as of Jun 3. David Valadao (R, incumbent) called by AP at 44.5%. Second spot uncalled: Randy Villegas (D) at 29.8% vs Jasmeet Bains (D) at 25.7% — Villegas leads by ~4%. Est. 34,000 ballots remaining. AP has not called the 2nd spot. (Source: NBC News / AP, 54.8% in)
George Whitesides (D) won CA-27 in 2024. Cook does not list as competitive. Lean D.
Redistricted per CA Prop 50. Linda Sánchez (D, formerly CA-38) now runs in new CA-41. Ken Calvert (R) moved to CA-40.
Top-two primary June 2, 2026. R candidates: Chi Charlie Nguyen, Mark Leonard, Amy Phan West, Chuong Vo, Thomas Vo.
Open seat (Darrell Issa retiring). D primary June 2, 2026 (top-two). Leading D: Ammar Campa-Najjar.
